sentences.text: Dame Angela Brigid Lansbury , -LRB- born 16 October 1925 -RRB- is a British-American-Irish actress who has appeared in theatre , television and film , as well as a producer , voice actress , singer , and songwriter .	Dame	Order of the British Empire
Her career has spanned seven decades , much of it in the United States , and her work has attracted international attention .

Lansbury was born to an upper-middle-class family in central London , the daughter of actress Moyna Macgill and politician Edgar Lansbury .	London	London	Moyna Macgill	Moyna Macgill	Edgar Lansbury	Edgar Lansbury (politician)	central London	central London
To escape the Blitz , in 1940 she moved to the United States with her mother and two younger brothers , and studied acting in New York City .	the Blitz	the Blitz

Proceeding to Hollywood in 1942 , she signed to MGM and obtained her first film roles , in Gaslight -LRB- 1944 -RRB- and The Picture of Dorian Gray -LRB- 1945 -RRB- , earning her two Oscar nominations and a Golden Globe Award .	Hollywood	Hollywood	MGM	MGM	Gaslight	Gaslight (1944 film)	The Picture of Dorian Gray	The Picture of Dorian Gray (1945 film)	Oscar	Academy Award	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award
She appeared in eleven further MGM films , mostly in minor roles , and after her contract ended in 1952 she began supplementing her cinematic work with theatrical appearances .	MGM	MGM

Although largely seen as a B-list star during this period , her appearance in the film The Manchurian Candidate -LRB- 1962 -RRB- received widespread acclaim and is cited as being one of her finest performances .	B-list	B-list	The Manchurian Candidate	The Manchurian Candidate (1962 film)

Moving into musical theatre , Lansbury finally gained stardom for playing the leading role in the Broadway musical Mame -LRB- 1966 -RRB- , which earned her a range of awards and established her as a gay icon .	Broadway	Broadway theatre	Mame	Mame (musical)	gay icon	gay icon

Amid difficulties in her personal life , Lansbury moved from California to County Cork , Ireland , in 1970 , and continued with a variety of theatrical and cinematic appearances throughout that decade .	California	California	County Cork	County Cork

These included leading roles in the stage musicals Gypsy , Sweeney Todd , and The King and I , as well as in the hit Disney film Bedknobs and Broomsticks -LRB- 1971 -RRB- .	Gypsy	Gypsy (musical)	Sweeney Todd	Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street	The King and I	The King and I	Disney	Walt Disney Animation Studios	Bedknobs and Broomsticks	Bedknobs and Broomsticks

Moving into television , she achieved worldwide fame as fictional writer and sleuth Jessica Fletcher in the American whodunit series Murder , She Wrote , which ran for twelve seasons from 1984 until 1996 , becoming one of the longest-running and most popular detective drama series in television history .	Jessica Fletcher	Jessica Fletcher	whodunit	whodunit

Through Corymore Productions , a company that she co-owned with her husband Peter Shaw , Lansbury assumed ownership of the series and was its executive producer for the final four seasons .	Peter Shaw	Peter Shaw (producer)	Corymore Productions	Corymore Productions

She also moved into voice work , thereby contributing to animated films such as Disney 's Beauty and the Beast -LRB- 1991 -RRB- .	Disney	Walt Disney Animation Studios	Beauty and the Beast	Beauty and the Beast (1991 film)
Since then , she has toured in a variety of international theatrical productions and continued to make occasional film appearances .

In 2014 , Lansbury was made a Dame by Queen Elizabeth II in a ceremony at Windsor Castle for `` services to drama , charitable work , and philanthropy . ''	Dame	Order of the British Empire	Elizabeth II	Elizabeth II	Windsor Castle	Windsor Castle

Lansbury has received an Honorary Oscar and has won five Tony Awards , six Golden Globes , an Olivier Award , and one Grammy Award .	Oscar	Academy Award	Honorary Oscar	Academy Honorary Award	Olivier Award	Olivier Awards	Grammy Award	Grammy Award

She has also been nominated for numerous other industry awards , including the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress on three occasions , and various Primetime Emmy Awards on eighteen occasions .	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress
She has been the subject of three biographies .
